verdict.rationale: Sierra documents guardrails as a configurable behavior (docs-8) and knowledge grounding via Help Center/FAQs/policies (docs-7), plus release governance controls (docs-18) and a benchmark emphasizing policy adherence (docs-27), implying guardrail infrastructure exists. However there is no explicit evidence describing safe-decline behavior for off-knowledge questions or hallucination prevention specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of decline/refusal behavior when the agent lacks grounding, hands-on or independent test showing it avoids inventing prices/policies, and any benchmark/eval result quantifying hallucination rate.
